FARE_TC.access: fair tree on UPDATE rows only (task label + SEX); own head (jcv.finalize.fit_head) on UPDATE+GUARD one-hot cells with task labels only, C chosen on the internal 15% group fold; GUARD SEX never used
FARE_TC.certificate: not computed and not claimed; a demographic-parity certificate is not an attribute-recovery AUC guarantee
FARE_TC.implementation: official eth-sri/fare via oar.fare_official (pinned commit 89cb1b66; patched sklearn criterion fair_gini_dp; the previously documented sensitive-buffer fix applies)
FARE_TC.nomination: among F1, F2, F3: same feasibility + lowest worst-seed coalition proxy rule (ties summed NLL then setting order); else descriptive fallback; matched zero-fairness control Z<id>
FARE_TC.zero_fairness_twins: one per setting (gamma 0, same k-bar / n_i)

RAW_J_NEQ.existing_artifact_search: no admitted artifact is a fresh neural RAW-J on UPDATE+GUARD with UPDATE-only SEX; the original lock records RAW_J as an exact alias of the historical RAW_PROJ (trained on all FIT with SEX), and N_EQ is task-only
RAW_J_NEQ.matched_task_only_continuation: T_NEURAL at the nominee checkpoint (identical loop, lambda 0)
RAW_J_NEQ.nomination: among rho {1,3,10} x E{2,5,10,20}: point-feasible on all 12 FIT2 clauses vs N_EQ in both seeds, lowest worst-seed FIT2 coalition proxy; ties summed FIT2 NLL, lower rho, earlier checkpoint; else minimum worst-seed normalized violation (descriptive fallback)

recipe.calibration: FIT-only: at the exact teacher with warm critics, 16 fixed draws; lambda_J_r(rho) = rho * median||grad CE_r|| / median||grad joint_r||; lambda_L_r(rho) = rho * median||grad CE_r|| / median||grad local_r||
recipe.optimizer: Adam per recipient network, lr 1e-4, betas (0.9, 0.999), eps 1e-8, no weight decay; clip_grad_norm 5 per recipient network (validated TCR1 continuation recipe)
recipe.privacy: joint (RAW-J): risk(income) + risk(occupation) + risk(pair); identical online critics/schedule/references to the tree arms
recipe.rng: same seed_for names as the tree arms, so task, privacy, critic and warm batches are identical row draws
recipe.start: admitted N_EQ (equally exposed neural task reference, UPDATE+GUARD, Recipe A)
recipe.strength_rationale: identical nominal grid to the tree arms (not weaker); the source TCR1 RAW-J grid was {0.3, 1, 3} under its own objective, and 1 and 3 are shared
recipe.task_only_continuation: T_NEURAL: the identical loop, batches and checkpoints with lambda = 0

T_REFIT_E20.choice: fixed in advance by the epoch-matching rule; no checkpoint chosen after seeing recovery
T_REFIT_E20.recipe: original task-only leaf-score continuation (same teacher, data, optimizer, batches) at the candidate epoch 20

endpoints.C1: L_TREE vs T_REFIT_E20: pair benefit mean_s[AUC_pair(T_REFIT_E20)-AUC_pair(L_TREE)] (privacy-training effect beyond continued task fitting: lower > 0; 0.020 also reported), income excess, occupation excess (upper <= 0.010)  [3]
endpoints.C2: L_TREE vs RAW_J_NEQ nominee: pair benefit (lower > 0.020 under the original criterion; lower > 0 reported), income excess, occupation excess  [3]
endpoints.C3: RAW_J_NEQ vs T_NEURAL: pair benefit (neural privacy effect beyond its own task continuation: lower > 0)  [1]
endpoints.C4: L_TREE vs FARE_TC nominee: pair benefit (lower > 0.020 if FARE_TC is a required comparator, else descriptive), income excess, occupation excess  [3]
endpoints.descriptive: L_TREE vs T_TREE and vs T_REFIT E5 (stored), T_REFIT_E20 vs T_TREE, RAW_J_NEQ and FARE_TC vs RAW_PROJ and the historical codes; J_TREE vs L_TREE at the common E20 checkpoint on FIT2 only (no new INNER scoring)
endpoints.inference: paired duplicate-group bootstrap (seed 2026101501, 2048 draws; the same INNER resamples as the original report), mean over seeds, Student-t Bonferroni over K=11, alpha 0.05, df = INNER groups - 1; PASS/UNRESOLVED/ESTABLISHED_VIOLATION and ESTABLISHED/UNRESOLVED/ESTABLISHED_SHORTFALL as originally defined

C4: as C2 for FARE_TC if required, else FARE_TC_DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY
labels.original_criterion_update: reported as an exploratory addendum (the original label is not changed)

endpoints.utility: 24 original clauses (vs U0 and Ucal) for each new service, reported with point and interval status (descriptive, outside the family)

designs: ORIGINAL: two-sided Student-t/normal Bonferroni simultaneous bounds over the full family (K=78 sensitivity and the claim-specific K)
IUT: one fixed global claim, each clause one-sided at alpha (recommendation from the statistics role, fixed before results are tabulated)

grids.occupation_brier_slack: observed point estimates and shifts of the excess by -0.002, -0.001, +0.0005 nats-equivalent units

feasibility_plan.inputs: per-group influence functions on INNER (already used) for every clause statistic of the frozen candidate and comparators, with duplicate groups as the unit; validated against the original bootstrap SEs
feasibility_plan.note: conditional power from selected development estimates is optimistic; no sample size is a promise

tables.A: ORIGINAL criterion: 24 utility clauses + benefit >= 0.020 vs every required comparator + no-excess
tables.B: NEW narrower prospective claim: 24 utility clauses + benefit >= 0.020 vs the incumbent RAW_PROJ + superiority > 0 vs the strongest utility-feasible code control + no-excess

frozen_candidate.reported_inner_values: reused from the frozen reader banks (stored INNER scores and releases); its readers are never refit or reselected
frozen_candidate.retuning: none (no new corrections, strengths, epochs, teachers, depths, temperatures, ensembles or allocations)

population_audit: documentation, provenance and safe metadata only; no prospective task/sensitive labels opened, no class frequencies, no fitting or scoring, no ranking by performance; unresolved history = UNKNOWN

readers.candidate_scores: L_TREE uses its stored INNER winner scores from the frozen banks; never refit
readers.controls: group-shuffled SEX and planted SEX bit (OUT_HGB) per view on the T_TREE wire; gates shuffled <= 0.60, planted >= 0.99
readers.procedure: task_headroom/reader_worker.py (frozen) via a verbatim copy tree_completion/reader_worker.py changed only in queue binding and required lock; 7 readers x 3 views per service, 14 ignore-one-recipient pair aliases, ATT train groups for fitting, ATT validation groups for orientation and winner selection, model seed 2026101205+seed
readers.replay_control: T_TREE is re-attacked in the completion banks; its INNER scores must reproduce the stored scores bitwise (procedure reproducibility)

release_contract: each recipient: own full-precision probability vector + argmax decision; pair = aligned concatenation (income then occupation)

remotes.github: https://github.com/Bostesa/PCRL.git (external; receipts are pushed here and verified)
remotes.origin: local mirror /Users/nathansamson/PCRL (never called a public registration)

required_status_rule: a new control becomes a required comparator for L_TREE under the ORIGINAL criterion iff its nominee is internally point-feasible on FIT2 in both seeds (same rule as the original lock)
status_of_this_work: EXPLORATORY completion of missing controls on already-used development people (UPDATE, GUARD, FIT2, ATT, INNER). Not replication, not confirmation. The original 78-endpoint report and its labels are unchanged.
